reason: A diagnostics plugin for debugging DeepSeek Harness model requests through bounded, content-free in-memory flight records, read-only queries, diffs, health statistics, and an optional /flight command.

summaries.zh: 用于调试 DeepSeek Harness 模型请求的诊断插件，通过有界的无内容内存记录、只读查询、差异比较和健康统计提供请求飞行记录。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness diagnostics plugin that provides bounded content-free in-memory request records, read-only queries, diffs, and health statistics for debugging model requests.

capabilities: Observes official Agent Loop requests and stream completion events
Retains bounded in-memory diagnostic records containing request metadata, structural names, counts, timings, usage, and finite failure states
Provides read-only process-local queries, comparisons, health statistics, and optional /flight diagnostics commands
Registers an optional locale preference and does not persist recorder records to disk
